name: Himuro Sayoko
source:
A voice actor who has been enslaved by Kenzou since she was trained by him, and has been getting work from him.

Before she got to know Kenzou, she was not very successful, but since then, her work has never stopped, and her ability and recognition have both increased.

She is unaware of her growing dependence on Kenzou.

[From [url=http://www.masterup.net/hina-soft/kuro_hina/injyokustudio3/index.html]official site[/url]]
